Web-grounded answers from the Agent API, raw web search results, and embeddings.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [console.perplexity.ai](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/keys)
- **Setting:** `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`
- **API reference:** [docs.perplexity.ai](https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/agent-post)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Perplexity and open [console.perplexity.ai](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/keys).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** An API key from the Perplexity console; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Apps POST to /v1/agent for researched answers and /search for result lists, and GET /v1/agent/\{id\} to poll a background run.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Perplexity) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  perplexity: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp provider show perplexity` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.perplexity.ai/orchestrator/v1/models` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** Agent API per token plus tool fees (web\_search $0.0025 a call); Search API $5 per 1,000 requests.
